name: Prisma
covers: Rerail's own Prisma rules, from the Prisma docs: one PrismaClient per process, request bodies parsed before they reach a write, and mail, payments and requests kept out of interactive transactions, on by default; queries run once per item of a list and raw SQL built from values, off by default.

rules.title: Prisma practice: pass values to $queryRawUnsafe, $executeRawUnsafe and Prisma.raw as query parameters, never pasted into the SQL text
Prisma practice: load or write a list's rows in one query (an `in` filter, include, createMany, updateMany or a $transaction batch), not one query per item
Prisma practice: create PrismaClient once per process, never per call in a route handler or server action, and in a Next.js app cache the module-level client on globalThis
Prisma practice: parse a request body or a Server Action's argument with a schema, or pick its fields, before passing it to a Prisma write as data
Prisma practice: send mail, charge payments, call HTTP APIs, enqueue jobs and revalidate caches before or after an interactive $transaction, not inside its callback
